name: REPORT-FTG_Web Filter: Access to Suspicious Category
description: The FortiGate web filter detected access to a suspicious domain categorized as a Newly Observed Domain or Newly Registered Domain. These types of domains are often used in phishing campaigns, malware delivery, or other malicious activities shortly after being registered. Although the request was not blocked, it may indicate an early-stage attack or suspicious browsing behavior. Investigate the source and destination context.
alert_name: FTG_Web Filter: Access to Suspicious Category
alert_description: The FortiGate web filter detected access to a suspicious domain categorized as a Newly Observed Domain or Newly Registered Domain. These types of domains are often used in phishing campaigns, malware delivery, or other malicious activities shortly after being registered. Although the request was not blocked, it may indicate an early-stage attack or suspicious browsing behavior. Investigate the source and destination context.
investigation_query_link:
dataset = fortinet_fortigate_raw
| filter cat = "utm:webfilter"
  and act != "blocked"
  and (
    requestContext = "Malicious Websites" or
    requestContext = "Phishing" or
    requestContext = "Spam URLs" or
    requestContext = "Dynamic DNS" or
    requestContext = "Peer-to-peer File Sharing" or
    requestContext = "Crypto Mining"
  )
| alter
    timestamp = _time,
    src_ip = src,
    dst_ip = dst,

    category = requestContext,
    action_taken = act,
    application = app,
    log_message = msg,
    request_origin = dhost,
    user = duser,
    device_name = _reporting_device_name
| fields timestamp, device_name, src_ip, dst_ip, category, application, action_taken, log_message, request_origin, user
